Coordination.Serialization.run:
{ℓ ℓ′ : Level} (Sys : System ℓ ℓ′) →
List (Event Sys) → St Sys → St Sys
Coordination.Serialization.run-++:
{ℓ ℓ′ : Level} (Sys : System ℓ ℓ′) (xs ys : List (Event Sys))
(s : St Sys) →
run Sys (xs ++ ys) s ≡ run Sys ys (run Sys xs s)

Coordination.Serialization.Trace:
{ℓ ℓ′ : Level} (Sys : System ℓ ℓ′) →
List (Event Sys) →
List (Event Sys) → Type (ℓ-max (ℓ-suc ℓ) (ℓ-suc ℓ′))
Coordination.Serialization.trace-sound:
{ℓ ℓ′ : Level} (Sys : System ℓ ℓ′)
{w = xs : List (Event Sys)} {w′ = ys : List (Event Sys)} →
Trace Sys xs ys → (s : St Sys) → run Sys xs s ≡ run Sys ys s

¬
((ℓ : Bool) →

¬

Coordination.Serialization.LinextConnected:
{ℓ ℓ′ : Level} (Sys : System ℓ ℓ′) (Schedule : Type ℓ) →
Type (ℓ-max (ℓ-suc ℓ) (ℓ-suc ℓ′))
Coordination.Serialization.same-result:
{ℓ ℓ′ : Level} (Sys : System ℓ ℓ′) {Schedule : Type ℓ}
(L : LinextConnected Sys Schedule) (u xs : Schedule)
(ys : St Sys) →
run Sys (LinextConnected.word L u) ys ≡
run Sys (LinextConnected.word L xs) ys
